watercolor illustration.constraints: Paint it in loose, transparent watercolor: soft washes that feather and bleed at their edges, darker pigment pooling where a wash has dried, gentle blooms inside each shape, and the tooth of cold-press paper visible only inside the paint. Build the scene from a few large, simple shapes rather than many small pieces, and let the washes define the forms instead of hard outlines. Lay every wash in the brand colors below and let two overlapping washes mix into a third; never outline in black, never shade with grey or black, and never paint the whole subject in one hue. An animal keeps its own natural coloring, painted in warm earthy washes with soft fur texture. Draw any person as an anonymous stylized figure with no facial features and no resemblance to a real individual. Leave the background fully empty and transparent behind, around and beneath the subject: no backdrop, no paper texture outside the paint, no floor, no ground shadow, no frame or border, no soft glow and no vignette, so the whole subject lifts off the page in one piece.

prompts.subject: a hummingbird hovering in mid-air beside three tall tubular flowers on one curved stem, its long thin beak reaching into the nearest flower, its wings spread wide and soft with motion, its throat a patch of iridescent green and red
a single chunky handheld tally counter, a rounded metal body with a ring for the thumb and one large push button on top, its small window blank with no digits
a single large old-fashioned key lying at a slight tilt, a round looped bow, a long thick shaft and a simple toothed bit at its end

one wide paper claim ticket seen straight on and lying perfectly level, a long rectangle of thick card about three times as wide as it is tall with small rounded notches cut into its four corners, a round hole punched clean through it near its left end, and a narrow stub at that left end washed in blue; the rest of its broad face is washed in very pale warm yellow, smooth and even and left empty

one single heavy chain link standing upright and seen straight on, a tall rounded oval loop bent from one thick round steel bar and closed all the way round, about twice as tall as it is wide, with a large empty opening in its middle; the round bar has solid volume and is washed all over in blue alone: deep cobalt blue in its shadows, clear mid blue across its body and pale sky blue where the light catches its curves, with the white of the paper left showing as small bright highlights

one single heavy chain link standing upright and seen straight on, a tall rounded oval loop bent from one thick round steel bar, about twice as tall as it is wide, with a large empty opening in its middle, broken open: a clean wide gap cut through the middle of its right side, so the loop no longer closes and its two cut ends face each other across the empty gap; the bar is washed in fresh green with soft pale yellow highlights catching along its curves
